欧文的生活方式(Owen's Way of Living): 一篇关于旅行出行的B1记叙文:欧文的经历、感受与成长。

Lily and Owen are preparing a report about the bus stop. Owen wrote down every idea in a small notebook. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. For example, paparazzi waited outside the hotel.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The experience taught Owen more than any book could. A lorry carried the new sofas away.

Owen keeps a small dog at home and feeds it every morning. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The ticket office has become an important part of daily life. In fact, my home screen shows a simple weather widget.

Little by little, things began to change. Owen has practiced table tennis for three years and won a prize last term. The bus stop looked quieter than usual that evening. Also, I heard a loud bang from the kitchen downstairs.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Lily always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Owen thanked Lily for the honest advice.
